products.name: Estimate Authorization Queue
products.product: A focused repair estimate authorization tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent auto repair shops and service-advisor teams
products.problem: Estimates waiting for customer approval are split across repair-order notes, calls, and texts, leaving bays idle and service promises uncertain.
products.valueProposition: Turns repair estimate authorization tracking into a visible operating queue so every pending estimate has a documented customer decision, next follow-up, or closed reason.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets auto repair estimate authorization, mechanic estimate approval software, repair order approval tracking, and service advisor follow up searches.
